window.note: Books start flat; START is the first bar each TF processes, so first possible entries are START+1h (H5) and START+4h (4h sleeves). 4h = complete epoch-aligned groups of four canonical 1h rows.

costs.native_funding: 1bp/8h per bar on qty x bar close (1h 1.25e-5, 4h 5e-5)
costs.target_funding: 1bp/8h per held hour on open qty x canonical 1h close

account.open_entry_risk_cap: 2.5% of closed cash; entry risk held until final exit
account.cairo_day_halt: realized net (fees, slip, funding) <= -3% of Cairo-day-start closed cash blocks entries until next Cairo day
account.same_coin: stack as separate lots; opposite sides coexist; no duplicate policy
account.phantom: refused candidate occupies own sleeve/coin until its tape exit; carries no cash or risk; screening approximation that can omit winners or losers; phantom hours reported
account.event_order: at equal timestamps: releases/exit cash first, then hourly mark, then entries by sleeve rank, coin rank, lot id; exit and partial cash at the exit bar end; funding at each hour end; entry fee at entry

orders.seeds: 1-39 random.Random(seed) shuffles sleeve and coin lists independently; same order for all books

label: PORTFOLIO_RESEARCH_LEAD iff at 15bp both paths COMBINED > each baseline in >=30/40 paired orders, COMBINED 15bp positive before and after 2025-10-01 (every order, both paths), COMBINED 23bp positive (every order, both paths); else NOT_A_LEAD. Descriptive, no activation.
terminal: open lots marked at the final available 1h close (no exit fee); they are not closes
